result.title: Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces
result.summary: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

AI.brief_summary: 该文为「信号-噪声分解」（SNF）与「信号-信号分解」（SSF）两项表示几何属性设计正则项，在 CIFAR-100 与受 MedMNIST-C 扰动的 BloodMNIST 上对比 L2 基线，发现增强 SNF 可提升性能、增强 SSF 未见收益；并进一步在留出数据上估计污染方向并从表示中投影剔除。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心思路是让干扰变化落入可识别、可移除的独立子空间，这与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、噪声旁路与内部状态清理的问题可能存在概念联系，可供核查如何去噪后保留任务必要信息；但论文限于单图分类，未涉及多模态推理状态或 latent 生成。
